currentStateEvidence.symptom: Primary-agent csm-plan/csm-build invocations stopped rendering TASK PROGRESS bars and persisting no records; this session's own invocations are examples. Fresh subagents do render bars (visible in dispatched task outputs).
rootCauses: L1 enforcement gap: the tracker is SKILL.md prose only; check-suite validates that each SKILL.md contains the Progress Tracker section and key phrases, but nothing verifies an invocation rendered the bar or persisted a record. Omission fails nothing, so behavior decayed across sessions.

L2 persistence gap: no canonical home exists. Plans, build states, reviews, research, and approaches each have .agents/ directories; progress records have none (.agents/progress/ absent). Zero csm-progress/1 or equivalent records exist anywhere in the repository.

L3 unfinished runtime: 2026-08-29-progress-tracking-runtime is blocked at commit boundary; 2026-08-30-progress-followups is in_progress at SELECT with T001/T002/T003/T005 pending. The schema (schemas/csm-progress.schema.json) that exists is the orchestration-graph snapshot (graphRevision/items/aggregate) - wrong shape for 3-6 invocation milestones - so agents had no valid record shape to persist even if they tried.
currentStateEvidence.designDecision: New csm-skill-progress/1 contract for invocation milestones, separate from the orchestration-graph csm-progress/1; extending the graph schema would break csm-orchestrate consumers.

rdRecord.question: Why did trackers stop appearing?
rdRecord.method: Repository investigation: grep for csm-progress records, read check-suite progressTrackerSection gate, read progress-runtime/followups plan states, inspected this session's own invocations.
rdRecord.isolation: Read-only; no repository mutation during investigation.
rdRecord.observation: Three layers: prose-only mandate with no record validation (L1); no persistence home and zero records anywhere (L2); runtime plans unfinished - runtime plan blocked at commit boundary, followups in_progress at SELECT (L3).
rdRecord.planImplication: Fix all three layers: record contract (L3), canonical path + index (L2), gate validation + per-skill output contract (L1).

rdRecord.question: Is the existing csm-progress/1 schema reusable for invocation milestones?
rdRecord.observation: Schema requires progressId/graphRevision/items/aggregate - the orchestration graph snapshot consumed by csm-orchestrate; milestones have no graph nodes.
rdRecord.planImplication: New csm-skill-progress/1 schema; leave csm-progress/1 untouched.

discoveredRequirements.requirement: check-suite's tracker phrase list includes the literal 'csm-progress/1'; changing SKILL.md prose to reference csm-skill-progress/1 requires updating that phrase list in the same change.
Root and payload SKILL.md tracker sections must remain byte-identical (payload drift gate).
Bar format is fixed: 'TASK PROGRESS  [bar] NN%' plus one milestone row with weights summing to exactly 100%, percent = completed_weight + active_weight x verified_fraction.
The 2026-08-30-progress-followups plan (in_progress at SELECT) overlaps this scope; reconcile or explicitly supersede it rather than running both.

design.summary: Add a csm-skill-progress/1 schema and shared helper (validate + render), enforce records through check-suite (schema validation + artifact index), add a short mechanical output-contract paragraph to every skill's existing Progress Tracker section, and roll child records into the orchestrator progress aggregate behind an opt-in flag.
design.helper: scripts/lib/progress-tracker.mjs exports validateSkillProgress(record) and renderSkillProgress(record) -> exact SKILL.md bar format; pure functions, no IO.
design.gate: check-suite gains: (a) schema-validate every .agents/progress/*.json; (b) artifact-index gate requires one README progress/ line per record; (c) tracker phrase list swaps 'csm-progress/1' for 'csm-skill-progress/1'.
design.outputContractParagraph: One added sentence in each skill's Progress Tracker section: at every state transition and at SAVED/COMPLETE/BLOCKED/PAUSED, render the bar and persist the record via scripts/lib/progress-tracker.mjs to .agents/progress/<date>-<goal-slug>-<run-id>-progress.json, indexed in .agents/README.md.
